=== nothing to push: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 0]
--- stdout
nothing to push: main has no commits the remote lacks
--- stderr

=== .github refused: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: <SHA> changes .github/ against the remote's main: CI would run it with the repo's secrets; the owner allows that with enforce.git_ci: true in the registry

=== no terminal: brunna push proj main
[exit 2]
--- stdout
!! .github/ differs from main on the remote: CI runs what it says, with the repo's secrets (allowed by enforce.git_ci)
push proj main → <TMP>/remote.git
  range: <SHA>..<SHA>, 2 commits
  !!<SHA>  Dev <someone@else.example>  from elsewhere
    <SHA>  Dev <dev@example.org>  add a workflow
  !! author emails not in the remote's recent history: someone@else.example
  changed paths:
  !!A .github/workflows/ci.yml
    A b.txt
--- stderr
refused: no terminal to confirm on: run it in a terminal, or add --yes

=== declined: brunna push proj main
[exit 2]
--- stdout
!! .github/ differs from main on the remote: CI runs what it says, with the repo's secrets (allowed by enforce.git_ci)
push proj main → <TMP>/remote.git
  range: <SHA>..<SHA>, 2 commits
  !!<SHA>  Dev <someone@else.example>  from elsewhere
    <SHA>  Dev <dev@example.org>  add a workflow
  !! author emails not in the remote's recent history: someone@else.example
  changed paths:
  !!A .github/workflows/ci.yml
    A b.txt
--- stderr
refused: not pushed

=== pushed: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 0]
--- stdout
!! .github/ differs from main on the remote: CI runs what it says, with the repo's secrets (allowed by enforce.git_ci)
push proj main → <TMP>/remote.git
  range: <SHA>..<SHA>, 2 commits
  !!<SHA>  Dev <someone@else.example>  from elsewhere
    <SHA>  Dev <dev@example.org>  add a workflow
  !! author emails not in the remote's recent history: someone@else.example
  changed paths:
  !!A .github/workflows/ci.yml
    A b.txt
To <TMP>/remote.git
   <SHA>..<SHA>  <SHA> -> main
pushed main: <SHA>..<SHA>. The project's own repo is untouched: its origin/main moves with its next fetch
--- stderr

=== refused: brunna push proj --force main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: --force: brunna push makes only a fast-forward of one branch (no force, tags, deletes or mirrors)

=== refused: brunna push proj --tags --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: --tags: brunna push makes only a fast-forward of one branch (no force, tags, deletes or mirrors)

=== refused: brunna push proj refs/tags/v1 --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: refs/tags/v1: brunna push pushes no tags

=== refused: brunna push proj :feature --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: :feature: name one branch, not a refspec (no deletes, no other destination)

=== refused: brunna push proj main:other --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: main:other: name one branch, not a refspec (no deletes, no other destination)

=== refused: brunna push proj +main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: +main: a + refspec forces; brunna push makes fast-forwards only

=== refused: brunna push proj main feature --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: one branch per call (got 2)

=== refused: brunna push proj refs/heads/main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: refs/heads/main: name a branch (as in refs/heads/<branch>), not a ref

=== refused: brunna push proj --bogus --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: unknown option --bogus

=== refused: brunna push proj bad..name --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: bad..name is not a branch name

=== not a fast-forward: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: main is not a fast-forward of the remote's <SHA>: merge or rebase onto it in the project first (brunna push never forces)

=== no such branch: brunna push proj nope --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: proj has no branch nope

=== origin None: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: the registry has no paths.origin for it: brunna push sends only to the remote the registry names

=== origin (native): brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: the registry has no paths.origin for it: brunna push sends only to the remote the registry names

=== origin ext::sh: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: paths.origin ext::sh is not a remote brunna push contacts

=== origin <TMP>/ws/proj/.git: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: paths.origin <TMP>/ws/proj/.git is in a folder a sandboxed project writes

=== empty remote: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: the remote's default branch can't be told (ls-remote --symref shows no HEAD; an empty remote?): its first push is not brunna push's

=== not sandboxed: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: proj is not sandboxed: push it with git as usual (brunna push is for sandboxed projects, whose repo the owner's git must not run in)

=== not registered: brunna push proj main --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
refused: proj is not in the registry

=== usage: brunna push
[exit 2]
--- stderr
usage: brunna push <project> [<branch>] [--yes]
